description: This file defines classes and structures for Bluetooth SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) socket communication, including Payload handling, PDU (Protocol Data Unit) management, and socket client/server classes with methods for serialization, deserialization, and PDU processing.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth SDP payload data, including pushing and popping various data types and sequences.

classes.name: PDU
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth SDP Protocol Data Unit with serialization/deserialization and payload inspection.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth SDP client socket communication, including MTU handling and command execution.

classes.name: ServerSocket
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth SDP server socket communication, including request/response processing and PDU management.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes various data types into the Payload buffer, including UUIDs, strings, booleans, integers, sequences, and buffers.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Extracts data from the Payload buffer, including strings, UUIDs, sequences, buffers, and enums.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the PDU into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a PDU object.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the PDU type, transaction ID, and builds payload content.
